product_statement: Document Protocol Lab ships as an interactive casebook that demonstrates and tests several approaches to business-document comparison with frontier LLMs, on the same public SEC filing pairs.
anti_hype_statement: This is a curated six-case casebook for comparing approaches, not a general document chatbot, broad filing catalog, or benchmark-grade model comparison.
why_this_mix_matters: Any frontier model can read a 10-K on a plain prompt; the harder question is which approach actually helps. NVDA, LLY, and KO anchor where structure earns its cost, sharpens the stop, or is honestly unnecessary. META, TSLA, and WMT put the same approaches under AI and governance pressure, policy shock, and interface pressure.
